scope: Offline sizing simulations; no source/network throughput measurement or production traffic distribution claim. RSS from /usr/bin/time -l is process observation, not the logical mapper threshold.

cases.notes: Repeated retained payload sizing simulation, not real network throughput. Raw payloads and source identities are unchanged; all tables are flushed together. Files use the production Zstd table writer. Physical protected transaction footer adds small per-file overhead.

harness_note: Measurements were collected during implementation on the stated source base. The committed reproduction harness is dda3ada: initial unchanged-payload runs used the same policy locally in the example; later varied-byte runs used the production FlushSizing module. The policy arithmetic is unchanged by that extraction. Subsequent main integration changes Cosmos and transport, not these EVM/Solana payload schemas.
